description: Gate A W4 (A05/A08/A10/A11) UI Lab visual-review evidence, post-remediation round 3 (F1, F2), following round 2 (N1-N4, A11-F1) and round 1 (R1-R5). Not an approved golden — requires human approval.
supersedes: The previous capture-attestation.json (CI run 38247353225, commit 370bcba87) predated round 3's F1/F2 remediation. Round 3 changed only the validation contract and fixture context (lineup-proposal-contract.ts, lineup-proposal-fixture.ts) — no UI component (lineup-proposal-editor.tsx) or page.tsx changed, so the rendered A10 states were expected to be visually unaffected. This was independently verified, not just asserted: 184 of 186 W4 capture files are byte-identical (same SHA-256) to round 2's attestation; the remaining 2 (gate-a-w4-a10-review-alternative-success-mobile-light-draft-preview.png and -pending.png) differ by only 15 pixels out of 78,400 in the diffed region, max per-channel value 2/255 — a sub-perceptible font-rendering/anti-aliasing variance between separate CI runs (confirmed via PIL ImageChops pixel diff and visual side-by-side comparison), not a real content, layout, or copy change. See BLOCKERS.md W4-BLK-14 (now resolved).
knownLimitations: sourceCommitSha above is the GitHub Actions pull_request-trigger synthetic merge commit (base main + this PR head), not the branch-tip commit — same precedent as every prior wave/round. reviewedBranchHeadSha is this PR's actual branch-tip commit at capture time.
Gate A W4 scenarios (scenario slugs prefixed gate-a-w4-) are CANDIDATE only — see docs/ui-lab/gate-a-w4-candidates/.

GitHub Actions artifact retention is temporary (expires ciArtifact.expiresAt) — a durable GitHub Release (07_GOLDEN_AUTHORITY_STORAGE_AND_RELEASE.md D7 strategy) has not been attempted; same disclosed gap as every prior wave/round.

The hashes recorded below are this CI artifact's own, independently re-verified in this session: all 698 files of this run's artifact (not just the 186 W4 ones) were downloaded fresh via the GitHub API (never `gh run download`) and every SHA-256 recomputed from the raw bytes — zero mismatches against both this file and the artifact's own self-reported manifest.json. The downloaded zip's own size (58304184 bytes) also matched the GitHub API's artifact listing exactly.

This run captures round 3's F1/F2 fixes at the validation-contract level only (TARGET_SLOT_OCCUPIED, EVIDENCE_TARGET_MISMATCH) — these are structural rejections exercised by unit tests, not new visible UI states; no new interaction-state slug was added this round. The real A10 success path (RCM genuinely empty) renders the same proposal content as round 2, confirmed by the near-total hash identity described in 'supersedes' above.
